verdict.rationale: Shortwave explicitly documents MCP client support: users click 'Add custom integration' and point to any MCP server (or build their own) to connect the AI Assistant to external tools like GitHub, Slack, Notion, Zapier, etc. This is corroborated by pricing page mentioning MCP and a security vendor blog acknowledging the MCP integration is live and functional (even while flagging attack-surface concerns). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of setting up a custom MCP server beyond vendor blog claims, and no detail on protocol version/auth specifics.
